findings.title: Page has very little text in the raw HTML
findings.message: https://example.com has only 19 visible words in the raw HTML. There is not enough text for AI assistants to extract or cite. Add substantive content to the page.

findings.title: No sitemap.xml found
findings.message: Could not fetch a sitemap at https://example.com/sitemap.xml. Sitemaps help crawlers (including AI bots) discover all your pages. Generate one and reference it in robots.txt.

findings.title: No robots.txt found
findings.message: No /robots.txt at https://example.com/robots.txt. Crawlers will assume open access, which is usually fine. Add one if you want explicit control over which AI bots can read your site.

findings.title: No structured data on this page
findings.message: https://example.com has no JSON-LD, microdata, or RDFa. Structured data is how AI assistants reliably extract who/what/when about your content. Add at least Organization (site-wide) and Article/Product (per page).

findings.title: No meta description
findings.message: https://example.com has no <meta name="description">. Add one — it appears in search snippets and is often quoted by AI assistants.
findings.fixSnippet: <meta name="description" content="A clear, 120-160 character summary of this page." />

findings.title: Very few internal links on the home page
findings.message: The home page has only 0 internal links. Add more navigation paths so crawlers can discover the rest of the site.

findings.title: No llms.txt found
findings.message: llms.txt is an emerging standard for telling LLMs which pages best represent your site. Very few sites have one today — adding one is a fast credibility signal.
findings.fixSnippet:
# https://example.com
# llms.txt — a curated index of your site for LLMs.
# Place at: https://example.com/llms.txt

# example.com

> Short description of what your site offers.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://example.com/): one-line description
- [About](https://example.com/about): one-line description
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing): one-line description

findings.title: No canonical tag
findings.message: https://example.com has no <link rel="canonical">. Add one to prevent duplicate-content confusion across query parameters, www vs apex, and HTTP vs HTTPS.

findings.title: No HSTS header
findings.message: Add Strict-Transport-Security to enforce HTTPS for repeat visitors. Not critical for AI citation but a standard hardening step.

findings.title: No <main> or <article> landmark
findings.message: https://example.com has neither <main> nor <article>. <header>, <nav>, and <section> are navigational or generic, not content landmarks. Wrap the primary content specifically in <main> (or <article> for a standalone piece) so content extractors can isolate the body from chrome.

findings.title: Add an identity schema (Organization or Person) to the home page
findings.message: Your home page has no Organization, Person, or LocalBusiness JSON-LD. AI assistants use these to know who you are. Pick whichever fits: a company → Organization, a personal site → Person, a venue with an address → LocalBusiness.

findings.title: No apple-touch-icon
findings.message: Add an apple-touch-icon for iOS home-screen shortcuts and certain AI-answer surfaces.

findings.title: No favicon detected
findings.message: Add a favicon — it appears in browser tabs, bookmarks, and some AI-answer source cards.

findings.title: No Twitter Card meta tag
findings.message: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"> for clean previews on X.

findings.title: Open Graph tags missing: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:type
findings.message: Open Graph tags drive how your site previews on social and in AI source cards. Add the missing tags.
findings.fixSnippet:
<meta property="og:title" content="..." />
<meta property="og:description" content="..." />
<meta property="og:image" content="https://..." />
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />

findings.title: <title> is short
findings.message: https://example.com title is 14 characters ("Example Domain"). Aim for 30-65 characters with a clear value proposition.
